text: DSH Session Deck 是面向 DSH Web GUI 的会话管理插件，在侧栏提供 Activity、Favorites 与 Workspaces 视图。它读取 DSH 会话状态和工作区成员关系，集中展示运行中、等待回复、未读及最近会话，并沿用原生置顶作为收藏。用户可以打开、重命名、分叉或归档会话，也能搜索归档并恢复原会话；完成提醒会更新未读标记，并可播放本地提示音或在已授权时发送浏览器通知。适合需要跨工作区跟进任务和找回重要对话的 DSH 用户。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web GUI；无需额外 API 密钥。

DSH Session Deck adds Activity and Favorites to the DSH sidebar, grouping active and unread sessions across workspaces. It uses native pins and supports archive search and restore. Completion alerts use unread markers and optional browser sound or notifications. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; no API key.
想在一个侧栏里查看所有工作区正在运行或等待回复的会话。
我希望把重要的 DSH 对话收藏起来，之后能快速找回。
哪些会话已经完成但我还没看？
能不能在任务结束时提醒我，并标出对应会话？
想按标题或工作区搜索已归档的会话并恢复它。
我需要从侧栏重命名、分叉或归档一个会话。
Show running, waiting, and unread conversations from every workspace in one sidebar.
Help me find and restore an archived DSH session by title or workspace.
查看跨工作区的活动与最近会话：侧栏 Activity 按状态和更新时间列出会话，并保留最多 20 条普通最近记录。
收藏并快速返回重要会话：Favorites 直接读取 DSH 原生置顶会话，显示其会话行并支持打开。
搜索并恢复归档会话：从归档列表按标题、工作区、路径或 ID 筛选，再触发恢复和打开。
查看会话完成提醒：运行结束后记录未读状态、更新页面标题和图标，并按权限显示浏览器通知。
管理会话条目：打开行菜单可重命名、分叉或归档；归档活动会话时会先显示停止确认，并报告操作错误。
DSH Session Deck 会在浏览器 localStorage 保存视图、会话未读状态和提醒记录；这些是会话 ID 与状态元数据，不含对话正文，清除站点存储会重置它们。

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH Session Deck — Session Management for DeepSeek Harness：**A Codex-inspired activity view for DeepSeek Harness.** Session Deck adds Activity and Favorites views to the native DSH sidebar. Track running, waiting, and unread sessions across workspaces, reply to sessions that need your attention, and keep important conversations close with Favorites.

The activity-view interaction is inspired by Codex and adapted to DSH's workspaces, session states, and native pinned sessions. Session Deck is an independent community plugin for DSH.

text:
@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Three views, one sidebar：| View | What it helps you do |
| --- | --- |
| **Activity** | Follow running, waiting, unread, and recent sessions across all workspaces. |
| **Favorites** | Keep important sessions close using DSH's native pinned sessions. |
| **Workspaces** | Return to the native workspace tree, its management tools, and other plugins' menus. |

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Three views, one sidebar：Switching views keeps your current conversation open. Session rows show the title, workspace, time, and status; their menus provide favorite, rename, fork, archive, and copy-ID actions.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Three views, one sidebar：Use **More → Show archived** to find archived sessions across workspaces. Search by title, workspace, path, or session ID, then click the row’s **Restore** button to restore and open the original conversation. Clicking the title or row does not restore it. Restoration keeps its recorded workspace position; it does not restart stopped tasks or restore a former pin. Failed restorations stay in the dialog with an error so you can retry.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Three views, one sidebar：When a session finishes while you are elsewhere, Session Deck plays a short two-note cue and marks the result unread. Each navigation tab has its own small blue dot: Workspaces and Activity reflect all unread sessions, while Favorites reflects only unread pinned sessions. Selecting a tab does not clear these indicators. Each workspace group carries its own unread dot. The browser tab also adds a blue dot to its favicon and prefixes the title with `(N)` until those sessions have been viewed. If the page is hidden or unfocused and browser notifications are already permitted, it also sends one silent system notification; clicking it opens that conversation. Opening a session clears only that session, and a dot disappears when its last unread member is viewed. Expanding or collapsing a group or changing views does not mark the group read.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Three views, one sidebar：*Screenshots captured from a local DSH installation in English; session titles and workspace names anonymized.*

| Activity | Favorites | Workspaces |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Follow active work and unread results. | Return to native pinned sessions. | Keep the complete workspace controls. |
|  |  |  |

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Three views, one sidebar：Screenshots show the switcher above the workspace region without host patches, below global panels. The interface and anonymized session titles are English; browser menus, tabs, and the address bar are excluded.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Install from npm：Install the latest release from [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck). As historical validation, the initial 0.1.2 release tarball was installed in isolation, its SHA512 integrity verified, and its host, client, and patch files checked against the source; this does not establish verification of later releases.

Requirements:

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Install from npm：- Node.js **22 or newer**.
- DSH Web GUI **0.2.1-rc.2**. This is the exact supported host version; other versions are unverified.
- DSH's native sidebar, session, and workspace plugins enabled.

Before installing, check the CLI versions and use the same profile as your running Web GUI:

```sh
node --version
dsh --version
```

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Install from npm：Expect Node.js `v22` or newer and DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`. These instructions assume you already have a working DSH Web GUI; if `dsh` is not found, install and start the [supported DSH host](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) first. If you launch DSH with a custom `DSH_HOME`, use that same value for plugin commands.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Install from npm：**Migrating from an earlier installation:** disable and remove the old plugin instance in DSH's plugin manager **before installing from npm**, to avoid two instances controlling the sidebar. You can keep its browser storage.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @yiliang114/dsh-session-deck@latest --ignore-scripts
```

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Install from npm：Replace `web` if you use another profile. Refresh your existing DSH GUI, then choose **Workspaces / Activity / Favorites** above the workspace region, below global panels. On the supported DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 layout, the plugin places the switcher there automatically without patching installed DSH files. The native workspace browser remains available in Workspaces. Refresh after client changes too; hot reload is not assumed.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Install from npm：The plugin's own labels are English. To make the rest of DSH English too, use **More → Settings → General → Language → English**. Session titles remain in the language you wrote them.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · First-run check (about two minutes)：1. Finish or close DSH's first-run dialogs. In **Plugins**, confirm that `@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck` is installed and enabled, then refresh the page.
2. Choose **Activity** and open an existing conversation that has started at least one turn. Newly created empty sessions are intentionally hidden, even if pinned; an empty list on a fresh profile is expected.
3. Hover over that session, open its actions menu, and choose **Add to favorites (pin)**. It should appear in **Favorites** and show a native pin in **Workspaces**.
4. Switch between the three views: the current conversation should stay open. Refresh again: Favorites should still contain the pinned session.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · First-run check (about two minutes)：If the switcher is missing, check that the plugin was installed into the Web GUI's profile and `DSH_HOME`, is enabled, and that the host version matches. The native sidebar, session, and workspace plugins must also be enabled. Look near the sidebar footer too: that is the fallback position when the supported workspace boundary cannot be found. See [Compatibility](#dsh-compatibility-and-switcher-position).

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · First-run check (about two minutes)：On 2026-10-25, version **0.1.8** passed this installation, navigation, favorites, archive/restore, GUI uninstall, and reinstall check in an isolated profile on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` with Node `22.20.0`. Session checks used local synthetic records without model calls; this does not verify live model-state transitions, OS notification delivery, or physical audio output, nor does it certify later versions.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Alternative: link a local checkout：```sh
git clone https://github.com/yiliang114/dsh-session-deck.git
cd dsh-session-deck
npm run verify
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$PWD" --offline --ignore-scripts

There are no dependencies to install. The repository includes the client bundle; `build` checks JavaScript syntax rather than generating it. Keep the checkout in place while using a linked installation.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Alternative: link a local checkout：You can also install through **Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin**: enter `link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-deck`, choose **Install**, then **Enable now**, and refresh the page.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Alternative: install from a tarball：To distribute the plugin without npm, run from the checkout:

```sh
npm run verify
npm pack --ignore-scripts
```

Copy the generated archive to the target machine, then install using its absolute path. Replace `VERSION` with the version in the filename produced by `npm pack`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/yiliang114-dsh-session-deck-VERSION.tgz --ignore-scripts
```

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Alternative: install from a tarball：Refresh the GUI. A tarball installation does not depend on the original checkout. Both linked and tarball installations place the switcher above the workspace region automatically on the supported rc.2 layout; neither needs a host patch.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Custom plugin market：The [market index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/dsh-session-deck/main/market-index.json) lists registry-verified npm releases. Add the following raw JSON URL as a source in DSH's custom plugin market:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/dsh-session-deck/main/market-index.json
```

This is a **user-added custom market source**, not an official DSH listing. Publishing to npm does not automatically add the plugin to an official DSH market.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Custom plugin market：Maintainers: pushing to `main` queues an automatic patch release (for example, `0.1.2` → `0.1.3`). Rapid pushes can be combined: stale queued runs skip, and the latest eligible run includes the accumulated changes. To choose a minor version, run `npm version minor --no-git-tag-version`, then commit and push normally; an explicit greater stable version such as `0.2.0` is preserved, and the following release becomes `0.2.1`. The workflow runs verification, creates the version commit and tag, publishes with provenance, and updates the market index and GitHub Release. See the [release guide](https://github.com/yiliang114/dsh-session-deck/blob/main/docs/releasing.md) for authentication prerequisites and recovery.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · How session status works：- **Activity keeps all running, waiting, and unread sessions**, plus at most **20 ordinary recent sessions**, sorted by DSH's `updatedAt` rather than last-opened time. Favorites has no 20-session limit.
- Favorites are **native DSH pins**, shared with the workspace tree. Activity and Favorites omit archived, subagent, and empty sessions; ordinary forks remain visible. **Show archived** lists all known archived sessions, including archived empty sessions and subagents, with no 20-session limit.
- Status priority is **waiting for a reply → running → unread**. A parent remains running while any known subagent descendant is running; ordinary forks do not propagate status to their source.
- Aggregation covers only descendants known to DSH's session directory. **Independent background shell jobs are not tracked**: an idle session does not mean every process it launched has exited.
- A session becomes unread when it and its known descendants finish while you are viewing something else. Opening it clears the marker; starting another active cycle also clears the previous result’s unread marker. Native Workspaces navigation ackno

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH compatibility and switcher position：This plugin declares an exact `engines.dsh` match of **0.2.1-rc.2**. Automatic top placement uses a DOM compatibility adapter for that release, not an official DSH extension API.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH compatibility and switcher position：| DSH sidebar | Placement mechanism | Session Deck support |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Official **0.2.1-rc.2**, without patches | No official `sidebar.workspaces.before` slot; the adapter places the switcher above the workspace region by default. | Supported target, with a precise rc.2 DOM structure guard. |
| **0.2.1-rc.2** with the legacy local patch | Reuses the existing `sidebar.workspaces.before` slot below global panels. | Compatible; the patch is no longer needed. |
| Official **0.2.1-rc.3** | The published client and slot contract still lack the before-slot. | Not supported: full compatibility is unverified and the exact engine declaration excludes it. |

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH compatibility and switcher position：On the recognized rc.2 layout, the adapter renders a React portal into its own DOM host immediately before the workspace region, below global panels such as Automation tasks. It does not write installed DSH files or replace the native workspace browser. An unknown DOM layout falls back to the footer. Disabling the plugin removes its scoped observer and DOM host.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH compatibility and switcher position：The More menu also lacks an item extension slot in rc.2. Session Deck inserts its own portal after Settings only when the native account trigger and menu match that version's layout. Native Settings, Feedback, account actions, and keyboard navigation remain available. Unknown or ambiguous layouts use a **Show archived** footer button instead. Disabling the plugin removes its menu container and observers.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH compatibility and switcher position：Workspace group headers likewise have no decoration slot in rc.2. The unread dot is added by a narrowly guarded adapter that recognizes native project rows and their real `workspace:<id>` key. It owns only its 6px marker, removes markers copied into animated exit rows, and does not identify groups by title or path. Unknown layouts leave the native tree untouched; Activity, sound, and session delivery continue to work. The always-mounted completion observer uses the official `shell.overlay` slot.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH compatibility and switcher position：The rc.3 published files were inspected on **2026-10-23**; that inspection does not establish plugin compatibility. Supporting another host version requires validating its session, workspace, slot, and UI APIs and DOM layout before widening `engines.dsh`.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Legacy sidebar patch rollback：The [sidebar patch script](scripts/patch-sidebar-before.mjs) is retained for rollback and backward compatibility. New installations do not need it. If you previously installed its local before-slot patch, the plugin can reuse that slot, or you can restore the original sidebar.

Locate the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` package actually used by your running DSH. From this repository, replace the placeholder with that package's directory, not the DSH root or this plugin directory:

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Legacy sidebar patch rollback：```sh
node scripts/patch-sidebar-before.mjs /path/to/dsh-client-ui-sidebar --rollback
```

Rollback requires the original adjacent `.dsa-before.backup` files and refuses to overwrite unrelated changes. Refresh the GUI after rollback: the new plugin still places the switcher above the workspace region on the supported unpatched rc.2 layout. If rolling back a DSH source checkout, rebuild the affected client artifacts as well.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Privacy and local storage：Session Deck uses DSH's session and workspace APIs. It makes **no model calls, sends no telemetry, and has no external upload endpoint**.

Browser `localStorage` retains the original keys for compatibility:

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Privacy and local storage：| Key | Stored data |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-session-activity.mode.v1` | Selected view. |
| `dsh-session-activity.pending.v1` | Session IDs, observed running state, and completion/unread metadata. |
| `dsh-session-activity.notified.v1` | Last notification revision delivered per session, used to avoid duplicate notices across same-origin tabs. |
| `dsh-session-activity.sound.v1` | Whether the completion cue is enabled. |

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Privacy and local storage：No conversation bodies are stored by the plugin. Favorites remain in DSH's native pinned data. View and unread state sync between tabs on the same origin, not across devices. If storage is unavailable, state stays in memory. Clearing browser storage resets this metadata; processed records are capped at 1,000, while running and unread records are retained.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Disable or uninstall：Use **Plugins → @yiliang114/dsh-session-deck**. Turn off the enable switch to disable it, or choose **Uninstall** and confirm to remove the package. Then refresh the GUI: the native workspace tree should remain, and **Activity**, **Favorites**, and the plugin's **More** menu entries should be gone. Disabling also removes the adapter's observer and DOM host.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Disable or uninstall：Your conversations and native pinned data remain. Uninstalling does not clear the browser metadata listed above or undo a legacy host patch; use the rollback command separately if needed.

If you prefer the CLI, use the same profile and `DSH_HOME` as your Web GUI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @yiliang114/dsh-session-deck
```

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Disable or uninstall：After CLI removal, restart that DSH Web instance and refresh the page. In the rc.2 acceptance check, the running host retained the plugin after CLI removal until restart; GUI uninstallation unloaded it immediately. Do not add `--ignore-scripts` to `remove`: the bundled pnpm does not accept that option for removal.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Development：```sh
npm run verify
```

This runs syntax checks, Node.js tests for session selection and state handling, and a dry-run package-content check. CI runs it on Node.js 22 and 24. There is no separate lint or TypeScript check, and automated checks do not replace testing the real DSH GUI.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · Development：The client lives in [lib/client.js](lib/client.js), with a minimal [host entry](src/host.mjs) and [Cordis configuration](cordis.patch.yml). Report bugs with your DSH version, installation method, and reproduction steps in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/yiliang114/dsh-session-deck/issues).
@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · License：[MIT](LICENSE). Independently maintained; not an official built-in DSH component.

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH Session Deck — DeepSeek Harness 会话管理插件：[English](https://github.com/yiliang114/dsh-session-deck/blob/main/README.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck) · [最新发布](https://github.com/yiliang114/dsh-session-deck/releases/latest) · [发布 CI](https://github.com/yiliang114/dsh-session-deck/actions/workflows/publish.yml)

text:
@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH Session Deck — DeepSeek Harness 会话管理插件：活动视图的交互受到 Codex 启发，并结合 DSH 的工作区、会话状态和原生置顶会话做了适配。Session Deck 是独立的 DSH 社区插件。

社区维护的第三方插件，默认英文界面，无额外 npm 依赖、无遥测，采用 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)。
section: DSH Session Deck — DeepSeek Harness 会话管理插件

text:
@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 三种视图，一个侧栏：| 视图 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| **Activity（活动）** | 跨工作区查看运行中、等待回复、未读和最近会话。 |
| **Favorites（收藏）** | 汇总 DSH 原生置顶会话，随时回到重要任务。 |
| **Workspaces（工作区）** | 使用原生工作区树、管理功能及其他插件提供的菜单。 |

切换视图不会离开当前对话。会话行显示标题、工作区、时间和状态，菜单提供收藏、重命名、分叉、归档和复制 ID 等操作。

通过 **More（更多）→ Show archived（显示归档）** 查看所有工作区的归档会话。支持按标题、工作区、路径或会话 ID 搜索，点击条目右侧的 **Restore（恢复）** 按钮才会恢复并打开原会话；点击标题或行本身不会恢复。恢复会保留原工作区位置，不会重启已停止的任务或重新置顶。恢复失败时弹窗会显示错误，便于重试。

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 三种视图，一个侧栏：当你在别处查看时，会话完成会播放一组短促的双音提示，并把结果标记为未读。每个导航标签右上角分别显示小蓝点：Workspaces 和 Activity 对应全部未读会话，Favorites 仅对应收藏中的未读会话，选中哪个标签不会清除其他标签的提示。工作区分组标题保留各自的未读蓝点。浏览器标签页也会在 favicon 右上角加蓝点，并在标题前显示 `(N)`，查看相应会话后自动更新。页面隐藏或窗口失焦且浏览器已授权通知时，同时发送一条静音系统通知；点击通知可回到对应会话。打开某个会话只清除该会话，最后一个未读成员被查看后对应蓝点才消失；展开/折叠分组或切换视图都不会把整组标成已读。

*截图来自本地 DSH 安装的英文界面；会话标题和工作区名称已匿名化。*

| Activity | Favorites | Workspaces |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 掌握运行状态和未读结果。 | 回到原生置顶的重要会话。 | 保留完整的工作区操作。 |
|  |  |  |
@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 三种视图，一个侧栏：截图展示无需宿主补丁、自动位于全局面板下方和工作区区域上方的切换条。界面及匿名化后的会话标题使用英文；不包含浏览器顶部菜单、标签栏和地址栏。

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 从 npm 安装：从 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck) 安装最新发布版本。作为历史验证记录，首次发布的 0.1.2 tarball 已在隔离环境中安装，SHA512 完整性校验通过，宿主入口、客户端和补丁文件均已与源码核对；这不代表后续版本已经完成相同验证。

环境要求：

- Node.js **22 或以上**。
- DSH Web GUI **0.2.1-rc.2**，这是当前精确适配的宿主版本，其他版本未经验证。
- 已启用 DSH 原生侧栏、会话和工作区插件。

安装前先检查命令行版本，并使用当前 Web GUI 对应的 profile：

```sh
node --version
dsh --version
```

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 从 npm 安装：预期 Node.js 为 `v22` 或以上，DSH 为 `0.2.1-rc.2`。以下步骤以已经可以正常打开的 DSH Web GUI 为前提；如果找不到 `dsh` 命令，请先安装并启动[受支持的 DSH 宿主](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)。如果启动 DSH 时使用了自定义 `DSH_HOME`，执行插件命令时也要使用相同的值。

**从旧安装迁移：**在通过 npm 安装前，请先在 DSH 插件管理中停用并移除旧插件实例，避免两个实例同时接管侧栏；浏览器存储可以保留。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @yiliang114/dsh-session-deck@latest --ignore-scripts
```

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 从 npm 安装：使用其他 profile 时替换 `web`。刷新现有 DSH GUI，然后在全局面板下方、工作区区域上方选择 **Workspaces / Activity / Favorites**。在支持的 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 布局中，插件会自动将切换条放到该位置，无需修改已安装的 DSH 文件。Workspaces 保留原生工作区浏览器。修改客户端后也需要刷新，不应假定热更新已启用。

插件自身文案使用英文。要让 DSH 其他界面也显示英文，在 **更多 → 设置 → 通用设置 → 语言** 中选择 **English**。会话标题仍保留用户原来使用的语言。

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 首次使用检查（约两分钟）：1. 完成或关闭 DSH 的首次使用对话框。在 **插件** 中确认 `@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck` 已安装并启用，然后刷新页面。
2. 选择 **Activity**，打开一个至少开始过一轮任务的已有会话。新建空会话即使已置顶也会被隐藏，因此全新 profile 中显示空列表是正常的。
3. 将鼠标移到该会话上，打开操作菜单，选择 **Add to favorites (pin)**。它应出现在 **Favorites**，并在 **Workspaces** 中显示原生置顶标记。
4. 在三个视图间切换，当前对话应保持打开；再次刷新页面，Favorites 中仍应保留该置顶会话。

如果看不到切换条，请检查插件是否装在当前 Web GUI 的 profile 和 `DSH_HOME` 下、是否已启用，以及宿主版本是否匹配。原生侧栏、会话和工作区插件也需要启用。同时检查侧栏底部：无法识别支持的工作区边界时，切换条会回退到那里。详见[兼容性](#dsh-兼容性与切换条位置)。

这是**用户自行添加的自定义市场源**，并非 DSH 官方收录。发布 npm 不会自动将插件加入官方 DSH 市场。

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 自定义插件市场：维护者：推送到 `main` 会自动排队发布补丁版本（例如 `0.1.2` → `0.1.3`）。连续快速推送可能合并处理：过时的排队任务跳过，最新可执行任务包含累计改动。需要手动选择次版本时，执行 `npm version minor --no-git-tag-version`，再正常提交并推送；显式指定的更高稳定版本（例如 `0.2.0`）会保留，下一次发布为 `0.2.1`。工作流负责验证、版本提交和标签、带 provenance 的发布、市场索引更新和 GitHub Release。认证前提与失败恢复请参阅[发布指南（英文）](https://github.com/yiliang114/dsh-session-deck/blob/main/docs/releasing.md)。

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 会话状态与边界：- Activity 保留**全部运行中、等待回复和未读会话**，以及最多 **20 条普通最近会话**，按 DSH 的 `updatedAt` 排序，而非最后打开时间。Favorites 不受 20 条限制。
- 收藏直接使用 **DSH 原生置顶数据**，与工作区树同步。Activity 和 Favorites 不单独显示归档、子代理和空白会话；普通分叉正常显示。**Show archived（显示归档）** 列出全部已知归档会话，包括已归档的空白会话和子代理，不受 20 条限制。
- 状态优先级为**等待回复 → 运行中 → 未读**。已知子代理后代仍在运行时，父会话保持运行状态；普通分叉不会向来源会话传播状态。
- 仅聚合 DSH 会话目录中已知的子代理后代。**独立后台 shell 作业不在跟踪范围内**，会话空闲不代表它启动的所有进程均已退出。
- 会话及已知后代全部停止时，如果你正在查看其他会话，它会标记为未读；打开即清除；开始新一轮运行也会清除上一轮结果的未读标记。从原生 Workspaces 列表进入会话时，已读确认不等待完成状态观察的排队锁。持久化记录可恢复刷新期间发生的完成状态，但无法补全所有页面关闭期间完整开始并结束、或从未观察到的运行。
- 每次实际观察到的完成最多播放一次插件提示音，并在后台且已授权时附加一条静音系统通知；刷新、恢复历史未读和仅子代理结束都不会补发提示，但下一轮完整运行仍会产生新提示。等待用户交互不算完成。通过 Session Deck 归档引起的停止会被抑制；原生或外部归档若先收到停止状态、后收到归档成员更新，仍可能被识别为手动停止。同源标签页在支持 Web Locks 时串行执行完成状态观察和提醒投递；共享存储不可用或不支持锁时仅尽力去重，不承诺严格一次。
- 每次本页观察到新的归档成员变化时，会清除会话已知的旧运行/未读基线，即使它暂时不在目录中。未变化的归档成员快照不会反复清除后来出现的共享记录，因为它们可能来自其他标签页的新活动；这些已处理记录随后参与正常的有界清理。仅凭目录缺失不会删除未读数据。恢复空闲会话不会补报旧的完成。如果恢复后的首个快照仍显示运行中，会保守地等待一次新的“空闲→运行”变化，因此恢复时已经启动的运行可能结束而不提醒。页面从未观察到的归档/恢复过程无法推断。
- 打开 Activity/Favorites 会话失败时会显示错误对话框，保留未读状态；关闭对话框后可重新点击会话或菜单重试。**Open in workspace for all actions** 仅在打开成功后切换视图。
- 提示音保持中性，不宣称成功：当前客户端状态无法区分正常完成、失败和手动停止。声音在本地合成，默认开启。可在

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH 兼容性与切换条位置：插件的 `engines.dsh` 精确声明支持 **0.2.1-rc.2**。自动顶部定位使用针对该版本的 DOM 兼容适配层，并非 DSH 官方扩展 API。

| DSH 侧栏 | 定位方式 | Session Deck 支持情况 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 官方 **0.2.1-rc.2**，未打补丁 | 没有官方 `sidebar.workspaces.before` 槽位；适配层默认将切换条放到工作区区域上方。 | 当前支持目标，严格检查 rc.2 DOM 结构。 |
| **0.2.1-rc.2** 加旧版本地补丁 | 复用全局面板下方已有的 `sidebar.workspaces.before` 槽位。 | 兼容，但已不再需要补丁。 |
| 官方 **0.2.1-rc.3** | 已发布的客户端及槽位声明中仍没有 before 槽位。 | 不支持：整体兼容性未经验证，精确版本声明不包含它。 |
section: DSH 兼容性与切换条位置

text:
@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH 兼容性与切换条位置：识别到 rc.2 布局时，适配层在工作区区域紧前方、Automation tasks 等全局面板下方插入自己的 DOM 容器，通过 React portal 渲染切换条。它不会写入已安装的 DSH 文件，也不会替换原生工作区浏览器。遇到未知 DOM 布局时回退到底部。停用插件会移除其限定范围的观察器和 DOM 容器。

rc.2 的 More 菜单同样没有菜单项扩展槽位。Session Deck 仅在原生账号按钮和菜单结构匹配该版本时，通过自己的 portal 容器在 Settings 下方插入入口。原生设置、反馈、账号操作和键盘导航保持可用；未知或存在歧义的布局会回退为底部的 **Show archived** 按钮。停用插件会清理菜单容器及观察器。
section: DSH 兼容性与切换条位置

text:
@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · DSH 兼容性与切换条位置：工作区分组标题也没有装饰槽位。未读蓝点由一个严格识别原生项目行及其真实 `workspace:<id>` 键的适配器添加；它只拥有自己的 6px 标记，会清理退出动画副本里的标记，不使用标题或路径识别分组。未知布局不会改动原生树，Activity、提示音和会话跳转仍然可用。常驻的完成观察器使用官方 `shell.overlay` 槽位。

rc.3 发布文件检查于 **2026-10-23**，该检查不能证明插件兼容。支持其他宿主版本时，需要先验证会话、工作区、槽位、UI 接口及 DOM 布局，再扩大 `engines.dsh` 的版本范围。
section: DSH 兼容性与切换条位置

text:
@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 旧版侧栏补丁回滚：[侧栏补丁脚本](scripts/patch-sidebar-before.mjs)保留用于回滚和向后兼容，新安装无需执行。如果之前安装过本地 before 槽位补丁，插件可以继续复用该槽位，也可以恢复原侧栏。

找到当前运行的 DSH 实际加载的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` 包目录，在本仓库中执行以下命令。占位路径应替换为该侧栏包目录，而非 DSH 根目录或本插件目录：

```sh
node scripts/patch-sidebar-before.mjs /path/to/dsh-client-ui-sidebar --rollback
```

恢复依赖原始的相邻 `.dsa-before.backup` 备份，并会拒绝覆盖无关改动。回滚后刷新 GUI：在支持的未打补丁 rc.2 布局中，新插件仍会将切换条放到工作区区域上方。如果回滚的是 DSH 源码仓库，还需重新构建相关客户端产物。

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 隐私与本地存储：插件使用 DSH 的会话和工作区 API，**不发起模型调用、不发送遥测、没有外部上传端点**。

为兼容早期版本，浏览器 `localStorage` 沿用以下键：

| 键 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-session-activity.mode.v1` | 当前视图。 |
| `dsh-session-activity.pending.v1` | 会话 ID、观察到的运行状态和完成未读元数据。 |
| `dsh-session-activity.notified.v1` | 每个会话最近一次已投递通知的版本，用于避免同源标签页重复提醒。 |
| `dsh-session-activity.sound.v1` | 完成提示音是否开启。 |

插件不在其中保存会话正文。收藏仍使用 DSH 原生置顶数据。视图和未读状态在同源标签页间同步，不跨设备同步；存储不可用时仅保留在内存中。清除浏览器存储会重置这些元数据。已处理记录最多保留 1,000 条，运行中和未读记录不受此清理上限影响。

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 停用或卸载：进入 **插件 → @yiliang114/dsh-session-deck**。关闭启用开关即可停用；点击 **卸载** 并确认则移除安装包。随后刷新 GUI：原生工作区树应保留，**Activity**、**Favorites** 以及插件添加到 **更多** 菜单中的条目应消失。停用也会移除适配层的观察器和 DOM 容器。

会话和原生置顶数据会保留。卸载不会清除上表中的浏览器元数据，也不会撤销旧版宿主补丁；如需撤销，请单独执行恢复命令。

如需使用命令行，请使用当前 Web GUI 对应的 profile 和 `DSH_HOME`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @yiliang114/dsh-session-deck
```

命令行卸载后，请重启对应的 DSH Web 实例，再刷新页面。在 rc.2 验收中，命令行移除安装包后，运行中的宿主仍保留插件，直到重启才卸载运行时；GUI 卸载则立即生效。不要给 `remove` 添加 `--ignore-scripts`：宿主附带的 pnpm 不支持在移除命令中使用该参数。

@yiliang114/dsh-session-deck README · 开发：```sh
npm run verify
```

该命令依次执行语法检查、会话筛选与状态逻辑的 Node.js 测试，以及打包清单 dry-run 检查。CI 使用 Node.js 22 和 24。没有独立 lint 或 TypeScript 检查；自动检查不能替代真实 DSH GUI 验证。

客户端位于 [lib/client.js](lib/client.js)，另有最小[宿主入口](src/host.mjs)和 [Cordis 配置](cordis.patch.yml)。反馈问题时，请在 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/yiliang114/dsh-session-deck/issues) 中提供 DSH 版本、安装方式和复现步骤。
